title: Study of ABT-263 When Administered in Combination With Either Fludarabine/Cyclophosphamide/Rituximab or Bendamustine/Rituximab in Relapsed or Refractory Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia

sections.abstract: This is a Phase 1 study evaluating the safety of ABT-263 administered in combination with either FCR or BR in subjects with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
